description: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, comparing four different metrics: Pop_GT, Pop_Ge, RPop_GT, and RPop_Ge. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Correlation" with a scale ranging from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1. Each category is represented by a group of four bars, colored according to the legend: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (orange with diagonal stripes), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (blue with diagonal stripes). The bars for Pop_GT and Pop_Ge are relatively short across all categories, with values ranging from approximately 0.05 to 0.3, while the bars for RPop_GT and RPop_Ge are significantly taller, with RPop_GT values around 0.35, 0.5, and 0.1 for Movies, Songs, and Basketball, respectively, and RPop_Ge values around 0.65, 0.7, and 0.2 for the same categories. The bars within each category are grouped together, with no sorting or ordering across categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
